title: Qualification strategy and torture corpora
summary: NoSQLServer carries a long versioned validation lineage plus SQL feature torture, SQL-92 company smoke, hell corpora and feature-specific regressions. New changes should run the narrow forcing test and the accumulated semantic baselines rather than trusting parser acceptance alone. For v0.91, tests assert create/open, atomic insert/update/delete/DDL, binary BLOB and INT64, WAL concurrent snapshots with an external writer, post-snapshot phantom and changed-row rollback, zero-match guard, successful retry and SQLite integrity. Supplied ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 debug and C++17/native sqlite3 bridge were the qualification environment.
invariants: A new parser path needs actual result-state assertions.
Keep wrong-result and execution-error outcomes distinct from unsupported/parse-error baseline classifications.
Do not weaken old oracle-backed/torture regressions to accommodate a new feature.
Scope historical SQL and Alchemy adoption tests separately; v0.87/0.88 Instrumentation Mesh, crash/disk-full, large-scale contention, portable ABI and production soak are NOT certified by v0.91.
Regression output supplied in the development candidate is historical test evidence, not a current runner execution by the sphere documentation update.

provenance.claim: Recorded PASS assertions, not a production certification.
